manifest.name: onevium-customer-voice
manifest.title: Customer voice
manifest.description: Turn selected customer feedback into an evidence-based theme report.

skills.name: analyze-feedback
skills.description: Analyze user-provided customer reviews or support feedback for a specified brand, store and time range, with traceable evidence.
skills.content: Confirm the brand or customer, source files, time range and output location. Use only selected inputs; do not reuse another customer’s data. Validate fields and missing values. Deduplicate records while preserving source identifiers and report the deduplication rule. Group feedback into themes; retain exact short evidence excerpts and their record references. Separate observations from interpretations and state sample bias. Never invent reviews, customer quotes, counts or statistical confidence. Write a report with sample counts, themes, evidence and suggested actions. Verify counts and output files. Do not upload source data to another service or contact customers without explicit authorization.

releaseNotes: Initial Onevium workflow. Runs locally in the selected scope.
